description: Finds every occurrence of a tile and returns its coordinates. Either via gid (flip bits are masked out) or via a tile property from the tileset.

gid.description: GID to look for. Compared on the tile index without flip bits.

layer.description: Name of the layer; inside groups also 'group/layer'. Alternatively use layer_id.

layer_id.description: Id of the layer. Unique, unlike the name. Alternatively use layer.

limit.description: Upper limit of hits shown. Default 200.

path.description: Path to ONE Tiled map file (.tmx or .tmj) — no directory, no wildcards. Please pass it absolute: a relative path is resolved against the working directory of the server process, and that is chosen by the MCP host, not by the project.

property.description: Alternatively: name of a tile property from the tileset.

value.description: Optional value for property, compared as text.

name: find_tiles
title: Find tiles
